name: Sonnet small/mid-cap growth
strategy: Equal-weight basket of high-growth small/mid-cap companies across software, fintech, biotech, industrials and consumer, selected for durable secular tailwinds (AI adoption, automation, digital payments, healthcare innovation) and reasonable momentum heading into 2026, aiming to outpace the large-cap-dominated S&P 500 over a 6-month horizon.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This basket targets mid-cap growth leaders with strong revenue momentum and secular tailwinds: fintech disruption (SOFI, TOST), public-safety tech (AXON), work-management SaaS (MNDY, APPF), data security (RBRK), satellite connectivity (ASTS), edtech (DUOL), and defensive growth in energy drinks/grocery (CELH, SFM). All are US-listed, liquid, small/mid-cap names with above-market growth rates, positioned to outperform a large-cap-weighted S&P 500 if risk appetite for growth stays supportive in H1 2026.
